name: Genesee County, MI
findings: Genesee County has 1,282 nonprofit organizations. 505 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 405 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Genesee County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Few professional organizations list membership
observations.text: 13 professional organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 27 would.

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through professional groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 97 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 97 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
